name: Dragonling Baby
description: The Winterworks baby Dragonling: a chubby young Ender Dragon in vanilla style: a big square head with flat 2 x 2 glowing violet eyes under a lid line, a flat box snout with nostril bumps and milk fangs, stubby grey horn plates, light grey spines from crown to tail tip, small flat membrane wings on bony finger spars and a long curling tail. Minecraft pixel units, density 1: exports 1:1 to a vanilla entity model.
